actions.title: What this computer can do
actions.summary: Which actions are ready, which need a step, which cannot run here.
actions.description: What this computer can do right now: for each action ready, needs_setup (with the step that fixes it) or unavailable (with the reason), and small facts such as free disk. Call it before telling a person how to do something, so the answer says what is missing.

domain.description: Only the actions of one area, for example 'speech'.
domain.title: Domain

actions.ui_exempt: It answers a question and is not a screen: screens show their own state.

actions.title: Make an audiobook
actions.summary: Read a whole book aloud, one track per chapter.
actions.description: Read a long text aloud as an audiobook: one track per chapter, optionally one track of the whole. It can take a long time; it returns a job handle.

text.description: The book. The chapters are found in it as audiobook.plan shows.
text.title: Text

whole.description: Also make one track of the whole book.
whole.title: Whole

actions.title: Find the chapters
actions.summary: Split a long text into chapters and estimate the time.
actions.description: Find the chapters of a long text and how long each takes to read aloud. Nothing is spoken or kept. Use it before audiobook.make.

actions.title: Dub a recording
actions.summary: Speak the script in the new language and mix it with the background.
actions.description: The second step of dubbing: speaks the (checked) lines of dub.script in the new language and saves the dub as a new track. Copying the original speaker's voice is not offered here: use a built-in or a saved voice.

text.description: What it becomes in the new language.
text.title: Text

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

voice_from.description: A built-in voice, or a saved voice (saved_voice).
voice_from.title: Voice From

actions.title: Write the dub script
actions.summary: Write down a recording and translate it, line by line, for a dub.
actions.description: The first step of dubbing a recording into another language: writes down what is said and translates it line by line with the times. Check or change the lines, then call dub.make with them. Nothing is spoken yet.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

language.description: The language to dub into (en, fr ...).
language.title: Language

background.description: Separate the voice from the music behind it first.
background.title: Background

text.description: What it becomes in the new language.
text.title: Text

actions.title: Change a picture
actions.summary: Change a picture of the library by describing the change.
actions.description: Change a picture the person already has in the library: say what to change. It makes a new picture and keeps the original. Use image.generate for a new one.

actions.title: Make a picture
actions.summary: Make a new picture from a description.
actions.description: Make a new picture from a description and save it to the person's library. Use it when the person asks you to draw, paint, make or generate an image. Write the prompt as a clear, concrete description in English. Returns the picture's id and size. To change a picture that exists, use image.edit.

prompt.description: A clear, concrete description of the picture, in English.
prompt.title: Prompt

examples.prompt: a red teapot on a wooden table
a cat dressed as an astronaut on the moon

actions.title: Stop a long job
actions.summary: Stop a job that can still be stopped.
actions.description: Stop a job. Work that already runs as a product's own run cannot be stopped: it finishes and is saved to the library. The answer says which it was.
actions.ui_exempt: A job is shown where it was started: on its card or its screen.

actions.title: Check a long job
actions.summary: How a job that was started earlier is going.
actions.description: The status of a job: the job_id an action returned while it was running.
actions.ui_exempt: A job is shown where it was started: on its card or its screen.

actions.title: Wait for a long job
actions.summary: Wait a little while for a job to end.
actions.description: Wait up to a number of seconds (at most 50) for a job to end, then give its status or its result. If it is still running, call it again.

seconds.description: How long to wait at most.
seconds.title: Seconds

actions.ui_exempt: A job is shown where it was started: on its card or its screen.

actions.title: Delete a creation
actions.summary: Delete a creation and its files for good.
actions.description: Delete one creation and its files. It cannot be undone, so the person is always asked in the app first.

id.description: The id from a search or a list.
id.title: Id

actions.title: Save a copy to a folder
actions.summary: Copy a creation into the export folder.
actions.description: Copy a creation out of the library into the person's export folder and return the file's name and path. It never replaces a file. This is the only way a file leaves the library.

id.description: The id from a search or a list.
id.title: Id

actions.title: Look at one creation
actions.summary: Show what is known about one creation.
actions.description: Get one creation by kind and id: its title, its date and its size.

id.description: The id from a search or a list.
id.title: Id

actions.title: List my creations
actions.summary: List the newest creations of one kind.
actions.description: List the newest creations of one kind (image, video, speech, track, transcript, voice, lipsync, notebook). Use library.search to find something by what it is about. Returns kind, id, title and small facts for each.

kind.description: Which sort of creation to list.
kind.title: Kind

actions.title: Rename a creation
actions.summary: Give a creation a new name.
actions.description: Change the name of a creation that has one (a song, a transcript, a voice, a notebook, a talking video). Images, videos and speech have no name to change.

id.description: The id from a search or a list.
id.title: Id

actions.title: Search my creations
actions.summary: Find things the person made earlier by what they were about.
actions.description: Find things the person made earlier (images, videos, songs, speech, transcripts, voices, notebooks) by what they were about. It names the things it finds but does not read inside documents: to learn what their documents say, use notebook.search. Returns kind, id and a short text for each.

examples.query: the song I made about the rain

actions.title: Lip sync
actions.summary: Make a picture talk.
actions.description: Make a picture of the library talk: a video of the face saying words (made into speech here) or a recording. The video is always marked AI-generated. It needs the person's word, in the app window, about the picture and the voice.

text.description: Words for the face to say.
text.title: Text

source_kind.description: Or a recording of the library.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

voice.description: A built-in voice for the words.
voice.title: Voice

picture_is.description: What the picture is: 'drawn' (artwork), 'own' (the person) or 'permission' (someone who agreed).
picture_is.title: Picture Is

voice_is.description: For a recording: whose voice: 'own' or 'permission'. Words are 'generated'.
voice_is.title: Voice Is

actions.consent: I confirm I may use this picture and this voice: the picture is artwork, a picture of me, or of someone who agreed; the voice is made here from words, my own, or one I have permission to use. The video is marked as AI-generated.

actions.title: Get a model
actions.summary: Download a model to this computer.
actions.description: Start downloading a model that is missing. The person is always shown the files and their size in the app window and must approve. One download runs at a time; follow it with models.status.
actions.consent: I agree to download this model to this computer. The files and their size are shown in the window before I approve.

actions.title: Models on this computer
actions.summary: Which models are here, partly here or missing.
actions.description: List the models this app knows, with whether each is on this computer (ready), partly downloaded or missing, and how much is missing. Filter by task (speak, music, transcribe ...).

task.description: Only models for a task: speak, music, transcribe ...
task.title: Task

actions.title: Model and download status
actions.summary: State of one model and of the running download.
actions.description: The state of one model (ready, partial, missing), the progress of the download that runs now, and the free disk space.

model_id.description: One model; omit for the downloads.
model_id.title: Model Id

actions.title: Make music
actions.summary: Make a piece of music, a song or a sound effect.
actions.description: Make a piece of music or a song and save it to the person's library. Use it when the person asks you to compose, make or write music, a song or a tune. Describe the style in a few words in English (genre, mood, instruments). Add lyrics only if the person gave them or asked for a song with words. Takes about a minute for 30 seconds.

description.description: The style and mood in a few words, in English: genre, mood, instruments.
description.title: Description

lyrics.description: The words to sing, if any.
lyrics.title: Lyrics

mode.description: A song, or a sound effect.
mode.title: Mode

actions.title: Write lyrics
actions.summary: Write song lyrics from an idea.
actions.description: Write song lyrics in sections ([verse], [chorus]) from an idea, to read or to give to music.generate. Nothing is saved.

style.description: The kind of music it is for.
style.title: Style

examples.idea: a song about a lighthouse keeper

actions.title: Split into parts
actions.summary: Split a recording into its voice, drums, bass and so on.
actions.description: Split a recording of the library into parts (vocals, drums, bass, other). Each part is saved as a new track.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

stems.description: Which parts to keep; all if omitted.
stems.title: Stems

actions.title: Add a note to a notebook
actions.summary: Add a text note as a source of a notebook.
actions.description: Add a text note (a title and the text) as a source of a notebook. It is read in the background and can then be asked about. Files and web pages are added in the app.

actions.title: Ask a notebook
actions.summary: Ask a question that the notebook's sources answer.
actions.description: Ask one notebook a question. The answer is written from its sources only, with [n] labels that point at the passages used. Use notebook.search to look across all notebooks instead.

document_ids.description: Only these sources; all the ready ones if omitted.
document_ids.title: Document Ids

actions.title: Create a notebook
actions.summary: Make an empty notebook.
actions.description: Make a new, empty notebook. Add sources to it afterwards.

actions.title: My notebooks
actions.summary: List the person's notebooks.
actions.description: List the person's notebooks with their ids and how many sources each has, to use as notebook_id in the other notebook actions.

actions.title: Search inside notebooks
actions.summary: Find passages about a topic across all notebooks.
actions.description: Look inside the person's notebooks (the documents, notes and pages they added as sources) for passages about a topic. Use it when they ask about something that may be in their own documents or notebooks. Answer only from the passages that are about the question, and say which notebook and source each came from.

actions.title: Make a Studio output
actions.summary: Make a report, quiz, flashcards, slides or another output from a notebook.
actions.description: Make an output from a notebook's sources and keep it in the notebook's Studio: report, study_guide, flashcards, quiz, mindmap, word, pdf, slides, datatable, audio, infographic. Slow ones return a job handle.

format.description: What to make: report, study_guide, flashcards, quiz, mindmap, word, pdf, slides, datatable, audio, infographic.
format.title: Format

prompt.description: What to focus on, if anything.
prompt.title: Prompt

actions.title: Text to speech
actions.summary: Read a text aloud in a voice and save it.
actions.description: Read a text aloud and save the recording to the person's library. Use it when the person asks to hear a text, read something aloud, or make a voice-over. Choose a built-in voice (voice), a saved voice (saved_voice, from voice.list), or leave both out. Takes a few seconds to a minute; returns the speech id.

voice.description: A built-in voice of the model.
voice.title: Voice

saved_voice.description: The id of a saved voice (voice.list), instead of voice.
saved_voice.title: Saved Voice

model.description: A model id; the best ready one.
model.title: Model

actions.title: Speech to text
actions.summary: Write down what a recording of the library says.
actions.description: Write down what a recording in the library says (a track or a speech) and save it as a transcript. Returns the start of the text and the transcript's id.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

actions.title: Animate a picture
actions.summary: Make a picture of the library move.
actions.description: Turn a picture the person has in the library into a short clip (2 or 5 seconds) by saying what should move. Takes minutes; returns a job handle when it is not done within the wait.

examples.prompt: the clouds drift slowly to the left

actions.title: Make a video
actions.summary: Make a short video clip from a description.
actions.description: Make a short video clip (2 or 5 seconds) from a description and save it to the person's library. It takes minutes on this computer and only one clip is made at a time, so it returns a job handle when it is not done within the wait. To set a picture moving, use video.animate.

prompt.description: What happens in the clip, in clear concrete words, in English.
prompt.title: Prompt

examples.prompt: waves rolling onto a beach at sunrise
a paper boat on a rainy street

actions.title: Copy a voice
actions.summary: Save a voice cloned from a recording.
actions.description: Save a voice cloned from a recording of the library (2 to 30 seconds of one person speaking clearly). It needs the person's word, in the app window, that the voice is their own or that they have permission. Returns the voice id.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

voice_is.description: Whose voice it is: 'own' (the person's own voice) or 'permission' (someone who agreed).
voice_is.title: Voice Is

reference_text.description: What the recording says, if known.
reference_text.title: Reference Text

actions.consent: I confirm this is my own voice, or that I have the permission of the person whose voice it is.

actions.title: Change a voice
actions.summary: Make a recording sound like a saved cloned voice.
actions.description: Make a recording of the library sound like one of the person's cloned voices (voice.list, kind clone). Keeps the original and saves the result as a new track.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

actions.title: Describe a voice
actions.summary: Save a voice described in words.
actions.description: Save a new voice described in words (age, tone, pace) so it can be used again. No recording is involved. Returns the voice id.

description.description: The voice in words: age, tone, pace. No brackets.
description.title: Description

examples.name: Calm narrator
examples.description: a calm woman, slow and warm

actions.title: Edit speech
actions.summary: Change some words in a recording.
actions.description: Change some of the words a recording says, keeping the voice: give what it says now (old_text) and what it should say (text). Saves the result as a new track.

source_kind.description: Whether the recording is a track or a speech.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

actions.title: My saved voices
actions.summary: List the voices the person saved.
actions.description: List the saved voices (described in words, or cloned from a recording) with their ids, to use as saved_voice in speech.speak, audiobook.make and the others.
